{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Replace sentinel values with NaN for analysis
trial_df_clean = trial_df.copy()
trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'] = trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Check the distribution of missing biomarker_baseline by sex
print("Missing biomarker_baseline by sex:")
print(trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].isna().groupby(trial_df_clean['sex']).mean())

# Check the distribution of missing biomarker_baseline by arm
print("\nMissing biomarker_baseline by arm:")
print(trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].isna().groupby(trial_df_clean['arm']).mean())

# Check severity distribution by arm and sex
print("\nSeverity distribution by arm and sex:")
print(pd.crosstab([trial_df_clean['arm'], trial_df_clean['sex']], trial_df_clean['severity']))"}
